t.5.2: You have no attachment to anything at all; pure as you are, what is it that you wish to renounce? Bringing about the dissolution of the bodily aggregate, in just this way enter into dissolution.
t.5.3: The universe rises from you like a bubble from the ocean. Knowing thus that the Self is one, in just this way enter into dissolution.
t.5.4: Though it is plainly perceived, the universe, being unreal, does not exist in you who are stainless, like the snake seen in a rope. Knowing this, enter into dissolution.
t.5.5: Being the same in pain and pleasure, full, the same in hope and despair, the same in life and death, attain dissolution even thus.
